title: Rug Radar
description: Rug pullers ended 45% of runs: a red arrow flashes at the screen edge half a second before an off-screen rug puller dashes, so you see it coming.

title: Golden Bull
description: A gold skin for the bull, earned (never bought) by clearing a Daily bounty, and shown on your share card.

title: Pump and Dump
description: A new bear that swells as it walks at you and bursts into six red candles when it pops, from 2:30.
